name: moviescriptbuddy
description: A personal screenwriting application inspired by Final Draft, Highland, and Fade In.

scripts.prep: mkdir -p www && cp index.html manifest.json www/
scripts.sync: npm run prep && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.deploy: npm run apk && adb install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb shell monkey -p com.scriptbuddy.app -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1
